title: Mortar.
officialText: Mortar for use in masonry construction shall conform to ASTM C 270 and Articles 2.1 and 2.6A of TMS 602/ACI 530/ASCE 6, except for mortars listed in Sections 2103.9, 2103.10, and 2103.11 of this code. Type S or N mortar conforming to ASTM C 270 shall be used for glass unit masonry.
